summary: The token has active on-chain mint and freeze authorities, enabling the holder to create new tokens or freeze any account at will. Despite a large market cap and apparent wide distribution, the uncontrolled authority combined with missing key holder/deployer data marks this as high risk.
red_flags: Multiple critical fields null (top10_percent, holder_count, deployer, total_supply, lp_burned)
green_flags: High market cap ~$472M and substantial liquidity ~$994K on Meteora
Estimated top holder owns less than 1% of total supply, suggesting decent distribution
ai_note: Although this could be a bridged version of the original Virtual Protocol (Base), the permanent mint/freeze authority on Solana still represents a classic rug‑pull vector.

sections.security: On‑chain analysis reveals a mint authority and freeze authority at G2TEhgz…, allowing the holder to mint unlimited tokens and freeze any balance. Off‑chain metadata flags are false, but the on‑chain authorities override that impression.
sections.holders: Holder count and top‑10 percentage are missing, but top addresses range from 5M to 256K tokens. Assuming ~1B total supply, the largest holder controls roughly 0.5%, implying reasonably broad ownership despite the data gaps.
sections.market: Traded on Meteora with $994K liquidity and $54K 24h volume, giving a healthy volume‑to‑liquidity ratio of ~0.05. Market cap is $472M and FDV $719M, indicating significant market depth.
sections.deployer: Deployer address is unknown (null). No information on dev exit or transaction history, adding to the overall opacity.
